verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LiveKit Agents is an open-source framework: a public GitHub repo at github.com/livekit/agents, documented open source plugins, LiveKit self-describing as an open-source platform, and a hands-on probe confirming the open-source framework installs from PyPI. However, no item names the specific license of the agents framework itself; the Apache-2.0 mention refers to livekit-server, not the Agents repo. missing for 10: an explicit license identifier (e.g. Apache-2.0) for the livekit/agents framework source, and first-party documentation or a LICENSE reference confirming the full framework source is readable under that license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: LiveKit is an open-source platform for building voice, video, and physical AI agents.
LiveKit Agents includes a large ecosystem of open source plugins for a variety of AI providers.
the open-source agents framework is real and pip-installable
